scope: Repository instructions, governance, CI, documentation and packaging metadata
reviewMethod: Static source and documentation review; no runtime tests run

components.name: Repository instructions and writing rules
currentBehavior: AGENTS.md carries the branch and Ryan/Nick merge restriction. Both root agent instruction files link the shared plain-language rules.
CLAUDE.md does not currently repeat the branch restriction or link AGENTS.md; host-specific loading of all required rules needs verification.
components.reusePlan: Retain root entry files and the shared writing rules. Extend their links as implementation contracts gain evidence.
enhancements: Consistent contributor and agent instructions for every language and plugin.

behaviorChecks.description: Each supported agent host loads or receives the shared rules and the Ryan/Nick merge restriction; add missing host-specific instruction links before qualification.
behaviorChecks.requiredEnvironment: Static instruction review and supported agent sessions

migrationChecks: Do not overwrite user instructions while installing plugins; preserve managed markers and user-authored sections.
limitations: Tool-specific instruction loading has not been tested; CLAUDE.md alone does not include every AGENTS.md restriction.

components.name: Design-pattern governance and recorded history
currentBehavior: Pinned catalog, baseline rules, project scope, registry, diagrams and source-digest review records form the existing governance gate.
Six active baseline findings remain recorded; current backend scope is not a qualification of the future frontend.
components.reusePlan: Retain checker, approved sources and historical records. Extend registry entries and change declared product surfaces explicitly when the frontend is introduced.
enhancements: Evidence for reused components and future plugin boundaries stays traceable.

behaviorChecks.description: The gate rejects stale reviews, missing pattern evidence and unresolved findings; prior records remain readable.

migrationChecks: Never reset adoption or erase findings to admit the new design; qualify new web surfaces before release.
limitations: Current check fails on six recorded baseline findings.

incrementalReviews.note: Six baseline findings repaired with preserved history and executed source-bound evidence; full platform acceptance remains open.

components.name: Continuous integration workflows
currentBehavior: CI performs syntax, selected hub/federation and dashboard suites, plus pattern governance.
A green selected job does not prove the tmux, browser, broker or hardware matrices.
components.reusePlan: Retain existing jobs and assertions; add isolated compatibility and migration jobs without replacing them with narrower tests.
enhancements: Baseline and candidate comparisons on supported platforms with explicit skip reasons.

behaviorChecks.description: Deliberately failing an existing assertion blocks the relevant gate; skipped environments cannot count as passes.
behaviorChecks.requiredEnvironment: CI with declared Node, Python and supported OS jobs

migrationChecks: Preserve test identities, environment requirements and logs across pipeline changes.

incrementalReviews.note: The existing CI unittest command now includes hub.tests.test_governance. Live broker evidence was collected in WSL; this edit does not add a broker to CI.

components.name: Git text, binary and privacy rules
currentBehavior: LF rules protect sourced shell scripts; explicit binary rules protect recovered bytecode, captures and images.
Ignore rules keep credentials, machine state, downloaded vendor manuals, caches and presentation locks out of source control.
components.reusePlan: Retain rules and add narrowly scoped entries only when new outputs require them.
enhancements: New plugins and release packaging preserve binary fixtures and exclude private state.

behaviorChecks.description: A fresh supported-platform checkout preserves binary digests and executable shell line endings; packaging excludes private runtime files.
behaviorChecks.requiredEnvironment: Git checkout and release-package inspection on macOS, Linux and WSL

migrationChecks: Keep source fixtures, agent definitions and license records versioned; never run text conversion over captures or recovered bytecode.

components.name: Product version and main user guide
currentBehavior: The version file identifies the release; README lists entry points, installation, authentication and operational workflows.
components.reusePlan: Preserve working commands while updating examples to the qualified plugin product. Keep compatibility instructions during transition.
enhancements: A new user can complete existing workflows and the added team workflow from published instructions.

behaviorChecks.description: Every advertised command and setup method resolves to shipped code or an explicit supported replacement.
behaviorChecks.requiredEnvironment: Clean supported host with documented prerequisites

migrationChecks: Label historical setup gaps rather than copying them into a supported product claim.

components.name: Harness contracts and known operational limits
currentBehavior: Documents preserve agent definition schemas, roster/worktree conventions and dispatch sandbox limitations.
Older contract text says the full gate repoints the live dashboard; current test runner uses an isolated server.
components.reusePlan: Retain amendment history; add dated corrections tied to code and link versioned replacement contracts.
enhancements: Instructions match actual isolation and supported client capabilities.

behaviorChecks.description: Run every advertised workflow in isolated fixtures; stale operational warnings are corrected with code evidence.
behaviorChecks.requiredEnvironment: Supported client/tmux test host; isolated data root

migrationChecks: Do not treat old documentation as current test evidence; preserve source and amendment dates.
limitations: These documents contain historical claims requiring reconciliation with current implementation.

components.name: Hub, federation and transport specifications
currentBehavior: Current verb, envelope, identity, account and terminal-delivery contracts document the existing installed system.
components.reusePlan: Retain old contract versions; add an explicit old-to-new command, event, permission and state mapping.
enhancements: Operators can move from shared-circle deployments to independent hubs without losing delivery evidence.

behaviorChecks.description: Every documented public verb and protocol field has a retained contract or reviewed migration entry.
behaviorChecks.requiredEnvironment: Isolated hub and NATS environments; pinned clients

migrationChecks: Keep prior behavior and topology decisions attributed to their version; publish mixed-version compatibility limits.

components.name: Historical handover and reference screenshots
currentBehavior: Handover and five screenshots preserve prior UI, implementation decisions and reported test outcomes.
components.reusePlan: Retain original evidence with dates; add current before/after captures using controlled fixture data.
enhancements: Reviewers can compare navigation, controls and meaningful display states across migration.

behaviorChecks.description: Each retained screenshot has provenance; new screenshots use the exact candidate and contain no private operator data.
behaviorChecks.requiredEnvironment: Static review and isolated browser captures

migrationChecks: Do not overwrite historical screenshots or turn old reported test counts into current pass claims.

components.name: Vendor documentation references
currentBehavior: Vendor links distinguish open Logix data-access protocols from licensed Windows engineering SDKs.
components.reusePlan: Retain references and redistribution limits; version references when qualified adapters change.
enhancements: Tool prerequisites and supported operations remain accurate for industrial plugins.

behaviorChecks.description: Each claimed vendor operation has a source/tool version and simulator or hardware evidence, with redistribution rights checked.
behaviorChecks.requiredEnvironment: Vendor documentation review and approved integration environment

migrationChecks: Do not bundle ignored vendor manuals or imply an SDK integration from a protocol library.
